Product Features

  • Tempered Glass Tabletop—Translucent, Scratch-Resistant, Safe, and Durable: The tabletop is crafted from gray translucent tempered glass with a diameter of approximately 19.6 inches. It features a premium, translucent finish, is heat-resistant, and resists scratches. The edges are finely polished and rounded to prevent bumps during daily use. Cleaning requires only a damp cloth, ensuring it stays as shiny as new for years to come.
  • Artistic Base - Streamlined Design: The base features a black spray-painted finish and a streamlined, artistic vase-like shape with smooth, elegant lines that exude a sense of sophistication. With a base diameter of approximately 12.8 inches, the wide, sturdy base provides stable support.The weight distributed across the coffee table is approximately 60 pounds.
  • Sturdy Construction, Wobble-Free: The base features a streamlined design with a low, evenly distributed center of gravity. Combined with the wide, thick base, it remains stable and won’t tip over or wobble even when holding heavy items. The junction between the base and the glass tabletop is reinforced with an aluminum plate, ensuring strong load-bearing capacity and peace of mind during daily use.
  • Easy to clean and maintain: The glass tabletop is water- and stain-resistant—simply wipe with a damp cloth to remove any marks. The metal base resists dust accumulation, requiring only a quick wipe to stay clean, making it effortless for busy households to maintain.
  • Versatile for Multiple Settings, Indoor and Outdoor Use: Indoors, it serves as a coffee table, sofa side table, nightstand, or can be placed in a bedroom corner. Outdoors, it can be set up in the garden or on the patio as a drinks table or display stand, meeting your diverse needs across various living scenarios. Its minimalist, luxury-inspired design complements any home decor style.
  • Multiple colors available to create your own unique space: The product comes in a variety of colors, allowing you to freely coordinate with your home decor. Whether you prefer classic styles or other color schemes, it seamlessly integrates into your home environment, helping you create a personalized corner that’s uniquely yours.
